title: Learn piano at home for less than $16 a year with this AI-powered app
excerpt: It's finally time to learn how to play the piano.
content_html:
TL;DR: Master piano from the comfort of home with this five-year subscription to flowkey Piano Learning App, on sale now for just $79.99 (MSRP $899) through Oct. 4.

Credit: Flowkey

$79.99
$899 Save $819.01

You don’t have to monetize every hobby. Sometimes, side hustle culture makes it feel that way, but you’re still allowed to do things for fun. If you’re in need of a new entertaining pastime, flowkey Piano Learning App makes it easier than ever to play piano.

Right now, you can lock in a fivef-year subscription to flowkey Piano Learning App for just $79.99 — less than $16 a year — until Oct. 4.

Learning piano isn’t how it used to be. Gone are the days of scheduling far in advance and learning boring songs in a classroom. There’s now an app for that — and with flowkey, you don’t even have to change out of pajamas. You’ll get a year’s worth of unlimited lessons for less than an hour of in-person instruction.

Mashable Trend Report

All you need is a keyboard or piano and a device to get started with flowkey Piano Learning App, then choose courses that range from beginner to intermediate, advanced, and pro levels. AI-powered learning gives you real-time feedback as you practice notes and chords, as it can listen as you play.

flowkey is filled with smart features to help you learn — like a loop function that repeats tough sections until you master them and slow-motion mode that slows playback so you can take your time learning. Wait mode only allows you to progress after playing the right notes, and hand selection lets you practice your left and right hands separately.

You can watch expert pianists play as you follow along on flowkey. The interactive lessons teach you chords and music theory as you play, so you get a good foundation, with over 1,000 classical and public-domain songs, including tunes by Beethoven and Bach.

Secure your own five-year subscription to flowkey Piano Learning App for just $79.99 (reg. $899) through Oct. 4.

StackSocial prices subject to change.
